name: trend-beat-switch
label: Trend audio / beat-switch montage
description: From ref 'My name is … but they call me…' (4.9M views): 3-4 s intro to camera with 2 white rounded caption boxes (setup + teaser), then the beat drops and every clip/image switches ON the beat (~1.5-2 s each) with ONE centred label word. Music-led (licensed/original for brands; trending sound in-app for personal), no subtitles.
